normalized_lessons.lesson: A renderer success message is not delivery proof unless the generated artifact has non-empty chunks and crosses a duration-aware byte threshold.
normalized_lessons.reusable_rule: No artifact-producing product may expose download/share/sales success until the artifact passes a deterministic non-empty/useful-size gate.

normalized_lessons.lesson: QA proof must be generated only after the improved workflow gate passes, not before or from a summary.
normalized_lessons.reusable_rule: Local/render proof payloads must be written after the acceptance branch and must include bytes, duration, mimeType, dimensions, media count and user agent.
normalized_lessons.expiry: 2026-07-23 after Android real-device evidence is collected

normalized_lessons.lesson: Daily learning audits must self-repair by creating or updating operational proof, not by restating failure.
normalized_lessons.reusable_rule: When a daily learning gate is missing proof, use the fallback to promote one safe operational rule or remove one harmful rule, then create eval, comparison and sync records in canonical paths.
normalized_lessons.expiry: 2026-07-23 unless automated test runner replaces static proof

promoted_changes.name: Studio render non-empty WEBM gate
promoted_changes.reason: Prevents false success when MediaRecorder produces no chunks or an unusably small WEBM.
promoted_changes.rollback: Revert commit ae628d8a4c20c9636458274c335a010368d2d221 or replace threshold with Android-calibrated value if valid playable files are below current minimum.

removed_or_rejected_harmful_rules.replacement: Success requires non-empty chunks and duration-aware minimum bytes before proof/download/share.

removed_or_rejected_harmful_rules.pattern: Counting reading, summaries, strategy docs or task boards as learning proof.
removed_or_rejected_harmful_rules.replacement: Only versioned operational rule changes with regression checks count.

cross_agent_sync.rule: Artifact-producing workflows cannot expose success, download, share, delivery or paid-pilot claims until generated artifact proof passes deterministic gate and regression cases are recorded.
